sources.who_is_counted: Registered refugees predominantly in state camps reported to UNHCR
sources.method: Reported to UNHCR by host government
sources.notes: Excludes unregistered persons and certain self-settled non-camp residents

sources.source_name: Ministry of External Affairs, Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 3974
sources.population_type: Sri Lankan Tamil refugees in India
sources.who_is_counted: 64,144 residing in 107 government-run camps + 36,861 living outside camps
sources.method: State government registers (Tamil Nadu Commissionerate of Rehabilitation & Welfare)
sources.definition: No national domestic refugee law; treated under Foreigners Act with special executive status
sources.notes: Direct breakdown: 64,144 in 107 camps + 36,861 registered outside camps in Tamil Nadu

discrepancy_explanation: The difference of ~37,843 individuals is explained by coverage: the Government of India actively registers non-camp refugees living in the community, whereas UNHCR historical records primarily reflect camp populations under welfare schemes.
